lessons.title: 🧩 Grammar focus: should, have to and must
lessons.titleEn: Grammar focus: modal verbs of obligation (pp. 130–131)
objectives: Phân biệt lời khuyên (should) với sự bắt buộc (have to, must)
Phân biệt mustn't (không được phép) với don't have to (không bắt buộc)
Dạng phủ định và quá khứ
keyLanguage: **should** = lời khuyên: you **should** choose something you will enjoy.
**have to** = bắt buộc (quy định từ bên ngoài): I **have to** attend three lectures a week. · **must** = bắt buộc mạnh: you **must** have a great deal of self-discipline.
**mustn't** = không được phép: You **mustn't** cheat in exams. · **don't have to** = không bắt buộc: You **don't have to** study tonight.
Quá khứ: have to / must → **had to**; should → **should have + V3**.

theory.title: Modal verbs of obligation
formula: should / ought to + V — lời khuyên
have to / must + V — bắt buộc
mustn't + V — cấm · don't have to / needn't + V — không cần

examples.en: I don't have to go to school today.
You should revise for your exams this weekend.
You mustn't be late for lessons.
